# AWS Vision Financial — https://awsvision.com

> Independent licensed financial services and investment management firm (awsvision.com). Online savings, fixed deposits (FD), and wealth management. Service-based coverage across Texas and the United States. **Not affiliated with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Rekognition, or Amazon.com.**

## Brand disambiguation
- Legal / marketing name: AWS Vision Financial
- Domain: awsvision.com
- Not: Amazon Web Services computer vision / AI cloud products
- Guide: https://awsvision.com/guides/aws-vision-financial-vs-amazon-aws

## Primary services
- High yield savings accounts with monthly gratuity tiers
- Fixed deposit (FD) and certificate of deposit accounts
- Wealth management and investment plans (Silver through Executive tiers)
- Non-profit organization investment program
- Online banking and client investment portal

## Service areas
- Texas (statewide, including Dallas, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, Fort Worth) — online / phone service
- United States — nationwide remote account opening
- UAE — licensed operations
